==Notes==
*Useful for running as the Health boost cannot be removed unless the user plans to attack.
* Has no [[duration]] (this is one of the few [[Upkeep#Skills that last indefinitely without an upkeep|skills that last indefinitely without an upkeep]]).
*When used for running, consider temporarily switching to an armor piece with a rune of superior strength before activating this signet.
*Can be used in conjunction with [[Illusionary Weaponry]] because Signet of Stamina won't end when you swing your weapon.
*Can be used by a mesmer to good effect with [[Symbolic Celerity]].
